input: Should our two-person startup build billing internally or use Stripe Billing? Write a decision memo comparing both paths. Judge them by implementation time, support for usage-based pricing, tax handling in the EU and US, vendor lock-in, reliability, and total engineering effort over the next 18 months. Reliability and launch speed matter most, but do not invent numeric weights. We need to decide before our planning meeting on 15 August 2026.

expected.objective: Compare building billing internally with using Stripe Billing.
expected.decisionToSupport: Whether the startup should build billing internally or use Stripe Billing.
successCriteria: Tax handling in the EU and US.
Prioritize reliability and launch speed without inventing numeric weights.
